calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date IN (DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-04')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS wk_end, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
  GROUP BY 1
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-20' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'wk' AS k, fiscal_year AS a, fiscal_week::VARCHAR AS b, fiscal_week_start_date::VARCHAR AS c, fiscal_week_end_date::VARCHAR AS d FROM wk
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales', wk_end::VARCHAR, units_sold::VARCHAR, NULL, NULL FROM sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'cnt', week_ending_date::VARCHAR, rows_::VARCHAR, stores::VARCHAR, loaded::VARCHAR FROM cnt

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL
